entities.summary: Benjamin Lee Kenney, is an American musician from Brielle, New Jersey. From 2003 to 2023, he was the bassist for the band Incubus and had previously played in the Roots as a guitarist. He also records as a solo artist, usually recording every instrument and singing all vocals on his records.
